facts.statement: using IAM credentials from an AWS account associated with Qubole between October 14 and October 26, 2026.
Qubole roles were still in place long after companies had stopped using Qubole

editorial.title: Qubole-linked credentials expose forgotten AWS integration roles
editorial.summary: Wiz and Sentra’s November 9 disclosures describe attackers using Qubole-associated AWS credentials to assume customer integration roles, collect secrets and access S3 data. Wiz dates the observed activity to October 14–26; this is a new disclosure of older activity.
editorial.why_it_matters: Dormant vendor trust can remain usable after an integration stops being used. An External ID did not prevent the observed role assumptions.
editorial.action: Inventory and remove unused vendor trusts. Review unusual role assumptions and S3 object reads, limit integration-role permissions, and investigate exposed secrets.
